notes: 14 searches. Not retrievable in second pass, so cut: 'non-binary people' (Macmillan/NHS say anyone who has testicles, including trans women), abnormal cells in testicle risk, lymph node surgery fertility effect, sexual health clinic route, 'checking feels awkward for anyone', hormone 'follow-up' claim reworded to PMC reviews. Banking 'other than removal of testicle' was wrong (Orchid advises banking before orchidectomy if chemo likely). Seminoma radiotherapy reworded: now mainly for those who cannot have chemotherapy. Prevention inference removed. Doubtful attributions kept with notes: scrotal-lump rarity, staging CT scans, and treatment overviews are blended in search summaries (NHS trust pages unnamed); infertility risk cites a PMC review not a charity. Age ranges differ between sources (NHS 15-49, Macmillan 25-40, seminoma 15-55 vs 25-55) and are presented as such. MedlinePlus 'one of the most treatable and curable' is attributed, no statistics.
